: It completed its $172.5M IPO on July 10 and placed $172.5M in the trust account.
: At September 30, it had $518,211 in cash outside the trust and $173.96M in trust assets.
: Management said the company lacks liquidity to sustain operations for one year and faces substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern.
